name: 侠客行 (The Quest of Oriental Chivalry) — 北美 2001 版
english_name: The Quest of Oriental Chivalry (North American 2001 Edition)
english_description: Based on Jin Yong's wuxia novel of the same name and centered on Xiake Island, where new players are greeted by one of the island's two envoys and led through registration before entering the wider jianghu. Part of the ES II / "Xiake Xing" engine family, this is a North American release circulated by the XiaKeXing Gaming Group in the late 1990s, with a faithful sect and martial-arts system and an unusually detailed death-and-resurrection sequence.
